_readme: Seed for skymp5-backend/data/faction-whitelist.json. Copy it there only while that file is missing or has no assignments.
type is hold, military or guild; a character belongs to at most one faction of each type. scope stays the id prefix (hold: or faction:).
Rank order 0 is the top of the ladder. leader carries every permission of the faction and may be held in one faction at a time.
recruit lists the rank ids a holder may bring outsiders in at; Recruit takes the lowest of them. promote lists the ranks it may move a lower member to.
remove, craft, housing, arrest and execute are the remaining permissions. capacity null means open. permission is always the rank id with dots.
title (and titleFemale) override the rank name when Show Title prefixes a character's name; the rank name is used when they are absent.
issuesUniform lets a rank hand out the faction uniform; uniform entries are { "item": "13ed9:Skyrim.esm", "count": 1 } and a rank uniform replaces the faction one.
regencyEnabled and regents (ordered, discordId + slot) are written from the game's Regency tab; a regent acts as leader while no leader is online.
Names, caps, ladders, rank lists and flags are edited in the dashboard Factions view or the Server Manager Factions tab.
